name: Sareyn
registryAssessment: Iran's national Organization for Registration of Deeds and Properties (SSAA) is evidenced as the cadastral/land-registration custodian, and public references identify an SSAA registration office in Sareyn. The official public systems located (ssaa.ir, my.ssaa.ir and Shamim) did not yield an anonymous city parcel-vector response with a safe native ID and geometry. No official Sareyn municipal cadastral viewer or public parcel API was verified.

queries.query: Sareyn Iran official cadastral parcel map GIS land registry
queries.result: Search found references to the Sareyn registration office and national SSAA/Shamim systems, but no official Sareyn parcel viewer or anonymous parcel feature endpoint. The public search results did not expose parcel schema, CRS, safe parcel IDs, or geometry.

queries.query: سرعین اردبیل نقشه کاداستر قطعه زمین سامانه GIS ثبت اسناد
queries.result: نتایج، اداره ثبت اسناد و املاک سرعین و سامانه‌های ملی ثبت اسناد/شمیم را نشان دادند؛ اما نقشه عمومی قطعات یا پاسخ ناشناس شامل شناسه امن و هندسه برای شهر سرعین پیدا نشد. سامانه شمیم برای کاربران مجاز/حساب‌دار توصیف شده است.

geometryDecision.reason: No safe native parcel ID plus full polygon was obtained. National service routes timed out or are described as restricted/authenticated, and no current official Sareyn public map/API configuration was exposed. The exact WUP point was preserved and not shifted; no exact-point parcel hit or absence claim was made.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: English and Persian discovery for Sareyn/سرعین, national SSAA land-registration/cadastre routes, Shamim surveying route, and the identified local registration-office reference.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: National custodian and local registration-office existence are evidenced, but citywide parcel-vector access, native parcel identity, schema, CRS, and exact-point containment remain unverified.
